decisions.reason: Accepting HubSpot default funnel reports does not change how MeetAlfred replies are represented in HubSpot Lead Status.
The reporting compromise retains HubSpot as the platform and does not change the candidate's CRM platform selection or setup scope.
Acceptance of default funnel reports does not affect whether email and LinkedIn communication history is visible in HubSpot.
The source decision concerns funnel reporting and does not change the HubSpot status behavior for accepted LinkedIn connection requests.
Using default reports temporarily does not alter CRM list grouping or movement of silent leads between campaign lists.
The reporting decision does not change silent-lead selection, follow-up list creation, MeetAlfred export, or cleanup requirements.
Acceptance of HubSpot default reports does not change the required transfer of HubSpot lead lists to MeetAlfred.
The source modifies only the funnel-reporting solution and does not affect Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization.
The reporting compromise does not change which LinkedIn profile URL type must be stored in CRM contact data.
The HubSpot reporting decision does not alter the workflow for creating a MeetAlfred campaign and configuring its Zap.
Accepting default reports does not change the requirement to connect the campaign email account to HubSpot.
The source decision is limited to HubSpot funnel reporting and does not affect exporting selected contacts from Sales Navigator to Apollo.
